sources.title: Original 11.15 fence executed in fresh bounded CPU helper
Area-average noninjectivity and patch-count derivation
sources.details: Each 8×8 block with one full-height bright column contains8 ones and56 zeros, so mean=8/64=1/8. Columns8 and15 belong to the same block: distinct inputs x₈≠x₁₅ have A(x₈)=A(x₁₅), demonstrated exactly. Any deterministic decoder g on that identical result has identical g(A(x)); it cannot equal both originals. A randomized decoder receives the same conditional input and cannot identify which original was supplied with certainty; language context may provide priors, not unique lost-pixel evidence. At fixed patch side P, divisible image dimensions give N=HW/P²; fixed20 text positions give total20+N and full attention table(20+N)². This is a construction/cost calculation, not an OCR trial.
